notes.title: Update to v2.12
notes.notes:
I've been working on the game in dribs and drabs since 2018, making countless small improvements and changes, adding some new features and tinkering with game balance. 

There have been so many changes, I haven't actually been able to keep track of them ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

This update also paves the way for Episode 3, which I am planning to have out before the federal election this year. 

Saves from previous versions will not be compatible with this version, however saves from this version will be compatible with Episode 3 when that update arrives!

Now is a great time to revisit the game or give Episode 2 your first play-through! Upon completion, you will be able to save your game and continue from that save when Episode 3 is released :)
